Welcome to the team! This guide covers your first week.

1. Day one
Collect your laptop and badge from reception between 9:00 and 10:00. The IT desk will help you set up your accounts. Passwords must be at least 14 characters; the password policy is described in section 5. Do not share your password with anyone, including colleagues and IT staff.

2. Equipment
Your manager will request any additional hardware (monitor, headset) on your behalf. Standard system requirements for your laptop are listed on the intranet page 'Workstation basics'.

3. Meet the team
Your buddy will walk you through the floor, introduce you to the admin team and show you the kitchen, quiet rooms and bike store.

4. Training
Complete the mandatory courses in the learning portal by Friday: Data Protection Basics, Information Security Essentials and Fire Safety. Each takes about 25 minutes.

5. Policies
Please read the code of conduct, the remote work policy and the expense policy. Questions can be sent to people@kestrelgroup.com.

6. Friday check-in
You will meet your manager at 16:00 to review the week and agree goals for the first 90 days. Note that probation reviews happen at 3 and 6 months.

Lantern Desktop 4.2 - Installation Guide

System requirements
- Windows 10 (build 19045) or newer, macOS 12+, Ubuntu 22.04+
- 8 GB RAM minimum, 16 GB recommended
- 2 GB free disk space
- A 64-bit processor with SSE4.2 support

Download
Get the installer from the Downloads page. Verify the SHA-256 checksum shown next to the installer before running it; the checksum for the Windows build is published at the bottom of this page.

Installation steps
1. Close other instances of Lantern.
2. Run the installer and accept the licence agreement. On Windows you may be asked for administrator permission; this is needed to install the background updater.
3. Choose the install location. The default is fine for most setups.
4. On first launch, sign in with your Lantern account. If you have forgotten your password, use the Reset link on the sign-in screen.
5. Open Settings > Sync to choose which folders to back up.

Command line install (advanced)
For unattended installs on managed machines, IT teams can run the installer with the --silent flag. The command is documented in the admin handbook. Example: lantern-setup.exe --silent --dir D:/Lantern

Troubleshooting
If the app does not start after an update, delete the cache folder in your user profile and relaunch. Note that this does not remove your synced files. For more help, visit the support forum or email support@lantern.example.

text:
Set up two-factor authentication - Orbit Help Center

Two-factor authentication (2FA) adds a second step when you sign in, so a stolen password alone is not enough to access your account.

Before you start
- You need the Orbit mobile app (iOS 16+ or Android 11+) or an authenticator app.
- Admins of a workspace can make 2FA mandatory for all members under Settings > Security.

Steps
1. Open Settings > Security > Two-factor authentication.
2. Select 'Set up' and scan the QR code with your authenticator app.
3. Enter the six-digit code to confirm.
4. Save your ten backup codes in a safe place, such as a password manager. Do not store them in a shared document.

Lost your phone?
Use a backup code to sign in, then register a new device. If you have no backup codes left, the workspace admin can reset your 2FA after checking your identity.

Note: SMS codes are supported as a fallback but are less secure than app-based codes.

Last updated 28 September 2026.
